chapter: Fletcher Henderson, Ella Fitzgerald and the early 1940s
title: Subbing for Cab and Benny Carter's group with Maxine Sullivan
summary: He played tenor with Cab for a few weeks in fall 1938, then Benny Carter took his small-group book to Boston with Maxine Sullivan.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Around '39, or something like that. And then in '38, the fall of '38, I went and played back with Cab Calloway in Chu's place for about three or four weeks while he had a vacation at the Cotton Club Downtown. I played tenor then.

And then I -- after the Nemo Club then I had this small group's book, Benny Carter and Maxine went to Boston and they used my book. There was Benny Carter and Al Gibson and myself. Benny was playing trumpet and alto. And I was playing clarinet and Al Gibson and Sonny White on piano. And I don't remember who the drummer was.
